title: Enhance categories
description: The category tree, parents before children: each entry's fields. lib/format/format.ts enforces this in CI and in Clyde's copy; validate.ts checks what spans entries: ids as name paths, parents first, frozen fields, retired ids.

items.errorMessage: a category: an object of its fields

id.errorMessage: a root (personal, business, or transfers), then one or two levels, each a dot and lowercase words of letters and digits joined by _

parent_id.errorMessage: null, or a top-level category's id: a root, a dot, and lowercase words of letters and digits joined by _

name.errorMessage: 1 to 40 characters starting with a letter or digit: letters, digits, single spaces, and the symbols & ' - / ( ) and comma

schedule_c_line.errorMessage: null, or a line number from 1 to 99 with an optional lowercase letter, such as "8" or "24a"

schedule_e_line.errorMessage: null, or a line number from 1 to 99 with an optional lowercase letter, such as "8" or "24a"
